description.value: Plaisir Sucré is a traditional French bakery and cafe in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, established in December 2009 by Fabrice, a Paris-born baker who brings daily fresh-baked croissants, artisan breads, and classic pastries to the counter. The family-run shop has been voted Best in Vancouver for its almond tartes and is known for its authentic atmosphere and kid-friendly environment with a dedicated play corner. Touring cyclists will find a full lunch menu of soups, quiches, and sandwiches alongside a complete espresso bar.
